# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 1: Fourth Odyssey Act I — The Western Crossing (oe_ely_). Generated by gen_elysia_exodus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Lightweight rebel-guarded fallback monthly pulse for Act I (BYZ / human TRE / human FEO).
# Deduplicated per country per month via oe_ely_ran_m; rebel-guarded per fx17_rebel_guard.py.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = { oe_ely_fallback_pulse oe_eln_elr_fallback_pulse }
}

oe_ely_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
		NOT = { var:oe_ely_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed }
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
				oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_landfall_v2_done }
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			tag = TRE
			tag = FEO
			tag = ELR
			has_or_had_tag = ELR
			has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
			has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_ely_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

# Lightweight non-BYZ fallback pulse for Slots 73-74 (ELR / TRE / FEO / ROM human Nova Elysia hosts).
# Disjoint from oe_mainline_lock (which only runs on BYZ), so BYZ never double-ticks.
oe_eln_elr_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { tag = BYZ }
		NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_eln_monthly = yes
		oe_elr_monthly = yes
	}
}
